LESSON: TRIGONOMETRY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry 4.3 Similarity and Enlargement (8 lessons) By the end of the sub- stran
Topic 4.4: Trigonometry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Trigonometry, part of Geometry 4.3 Similarity and Enlargement (8 lessons) By the end of the sub- stran in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How is the relationship between angles and sides in a right angled triangle?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Draw/ trace/ mount/ stamp right angled triangles and recognize angles and sides. Discuss the relationship between angles and sides in purposive groups/pairs. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication to discuss the relationships.

2. Discuss in purposive groups/pairs and relate the trigonometric ratios to angles in a right

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Draw/ trace/ mount/ stamp right angled triangles and recognize angles and sides. Discuss the relationship between angles and sides in purposive groups/pairs. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication to discuss the relationships.
2. Discuss in purposive groups/pairs and relate the trigonometric ratios to angles in a right

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Trigonometry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving - as the learner relates the trigonometric ratios to angles in a right angled triangle.

● Digital literacy - as the learner uses tables or calculators to find trigonometric ratios of given angles.

Values:
Responsibility - as the learner takes care of digital devices, mathematical tables and drawing materials.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety - as the learner plugs and uses digital devices carefully.

Link to other subjects:

Pre-Technical Studies as the learner draws right angled triangles and recognizes angles and sides.
